reason: Announced 2026-08-10; no newer change item replaces it. Corpus (EC2 and Auto Scaling user guides) still describes opt-in application status checks that Auto Scaling groups act on.

The 2026-06-18 item only widens supported Intel platforms and Regions; it does not replace the 2026-02-16 addition of nested virtualization on virtual instances. The EC2 user guide still says non-bare metal instances can run hypervisors.
No later change item replaces the 2022-11 addition; the current EC2 and Auto Scaling guides still list price-capacity-optimized and recommend it.
